bluetooth_method.title: Add EnOcean BLE switch
bluetooth_method.description:
Switch {name} ({mac}) was discovered. How do you want to add it?

The QR code is on the label of the EnOcean module, behind the rocker.

menu_options.qr_scan: Scan the QR code with the camera

qr_text.title: Enter the QR code text
qr_text.description: Type or paste the text of the QR code on the module label of {name}. Only two parts are needed: the address after 30S (12 characters, {mac} without the colons) and the key after +Z (32 characters). The rest of the text is ignored and can be left out.

qr_scan.title: Scan the QR code
qr_scan.description: Open the scan page and aim at the QR code on the module label of {name}. On a computer, the page shows a QR code to open it on your phone. This dialog continues by itself once the QR code has been scanned.

qr_scan_done.title: QR code validated
qr_scan_done.description: The QR code matches switch {name} ({mac}). Click Submit to add it.

qr_scan_error.title: QR code rejected
qr_scan_error.description: The scanned QR code cannot be used to add switch {name} ({mac}). Click Submit to choose how to add it again, or close this dialog.

commissioning.title: EnOcean BLE Auto-Commissioning
commissioning.description:
Activate auto-commissioning on {name}:

1. Hold button 1 for 7 seconds
2. Press button 1 briefly
3. Hold button 1 again for 7 seconds

You have 2 minutes. Retry if needed.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm EnOcean BLE Device
bluetooth_confirm.description:
EnOcean switch with address {mac} was commissioned successfully.

⚠️ Press another button to disable commissioning mode, then click Submit.

button_mode.title: Button mode
button_mode.description:
Choose how the buttons of {name} work. You can change it later with the Configure button.

Short + long and Short + hold need the release to be received. If it is lost, the action is lost, and with Short + hold a hold can run for up to 8 seconds. More Bluetooth receivers near the switch make this rare (see Troubleshooting in the documentation).

progress.waiting_commissioning: Hold button 1 for 7 seconds, then press button 1 briefly, and hold again for 7 seconds.

abort.no_bluetooth_discovery: This setup must start from a discovered Bluetooth device.
abort.not_enocean_prefix: This discovered device does not use the EnOcean BLE MAC prefix (E2:15).
abort.discovery_required: Press any button on the switch: it then appears as a discovered device in Settings → Devices & services, where you can add it.

error.invalid_qr: No EnOcean switch address (30SE215…) and 32-character security key (+Z…) were found in this text.
error.commissioning_not_detected: No commissioning telegram was received within 2 minutes. Try again. If it still does not work after multiple attempts, you can try a factory reset. Please read the reset disclaimer in the documentation first.
error.invalid_commissioning: A commissioning telegram was received but could not be validated. Try again. If this keeps failing, review the factory reset disclaimer in the documentation before resetting.
error.qr_mac_mismatch: This QR code belongs to another switch than the one that was discovered.
error.qr_key_invalid: The key in this QR code does not match the telegrams received from this switch. It may have been reconfigured (for example by another system).
error.qr_no_telegram: No telegram has been received from this switch yet. Press one of its buttons, then try again.
error.scan_https_required: Scanning with the camera needs Home Assistant to be reachable over HTTPS. Enter the QR code text instead.

init.title: Button mode
init.description:
Choose how the buttons of this switch work. Automations that use its events may need to be updated.

Short + long and Short + hold need the release to be received. If it is lost, the action is lost, and with Short + hold a hold can run for up to 8 seconds. More Bluetooth receivers near the switch make this rare (see Troubleshooting in the documentation).

confirm.title: Choose a button mode for {name}
confirm.description:
{name} uses the **Legacy** mode of earlier versions. Your automations keep working, but this mode will be removed in a future version. Choose a new mode, then update the automations that use this switch:

| Legacy | Simple | Short + long | Short + hold |
|---|---|---|---|
| `single_press` | `single_press` | `short_press` | `short_press` |
| `long_press` | — | `long_press` | `hold_press` |
| `long_release` | — | — | `hold_release` |
| `release_timeout` | — | — | `hold_release` |
| `press` | `raw_press` | `raw_press` | `raw_press` |
| `release`, `orphan_release` | `raw_release` | `raw_release` | `raw_release` |

In the new modes, trigger automations with **Event received** on the button entities (A0, A1, B0, B1). The "A0 event" sensors are removed. raw_press and raw_release are on the "A0 raw" entities, disabled by default. To keep the Legacy mode for now, leave **Legacy** selected.

options.simple: Simple: one action per button, runs on press. Most reliable.
options.short_long: Short + long: short press (<1 s) or long press (>1 s), runs on release.
options.short_hold: Short + hold: short press (<1 s), or hold (>1 s) to adjust continuously.
options.legacy: Legacy: events of earlier versions, removed in a future version.
